messages.text: Starting session with Clara - Dental Receptionist (Rachel voice)...
Hi, thanks for calling Bright Smile Dental! How can I help you today?
I can help you schedule, reschedule, or cancel a dental appointment, share our clinic hours, location, and accepted insurance, and connect you with urgent care if needed. How can I assist you today?

Ji bilkul, main Hindi mein baat kar sakti hoon. Main Bright Smile Dental ki receptionist Clara hoon, aur aapki appointment book karne, badalne ya cancel karne mein madad kar sakti hoon. Bataiye, aap kis liye call kar rahe hain?
Kya aap wahan hain? Main aapki madad karne ke liye yahan hoon, bas batayiye aapko kya chahiye.
Ji zaroor, main aapki appointment book karne mein madad karungi. Kripya apna naam, pasandida din aur samay, aur contact number bata dijiye.
Theek hai, kal ke liye appointment note kar leti hoon. Kripya apna naam, pasandida samay, aur contact number bata dijiye taaki main booking confirm kar sakoon.
Shukriya Sunny ji. Ab kripya apna pasandida samay aur contact number bata dijiye, taaki main kal ki appointment confirm kar sakoon.
Theek hai, kal dopahar chhe baje ka samay note kar liya. Ab kripya apna contact number bata dijiye taaki main appointment confirm kar sakoon.

Dhanyavaad Sunny ji, main aapki appointment kal dopahar chhe baje ke liye note kar rahi hoon. Aapka number bhi le liya hai, hum aapko confirm karne ke liye call karenge. Kya aapko koi khaas dikkat ya ilaaj ke baare mein batana hai?
Koi baat nahi Sunny ji, main aapki appointment kal dopahar chhe baje ke liye confirm kar deti hoon. Agar aapko koi aur jaankari chahiye ya samay badalna ho, toh bata dijiye.
Theek hai Sunny ji, aapki appointment kal dopahar chhe baje ke liye book kar li gayi hai. Bright Smile Dental mein aapka intezaar rahega, dhanyavaad!
Alvida Sunny ji, apna khayal rakhiye aur kal milte hain. Dhanyavaad!
Starting session with HolaAmiga (Sarah voice)...
¡Hola! I am so excited to practice Spanish with you today. What would you like to talk about?
Could you explain the difference between por and para?

Of course, I would be happy to help. Por is often used for reasons, like saying gracias por tu ayuda, while para is used for purposes or destinations, like este regalo es para ti. Would you like to try making a sentence with one of them?
Starting session with Clara Clinic Receptionist (Sarah voice)...
Hello! Thank you for calling City Health Clinic. How can I assist you today?
Hi there, I'm still here and happy to help. Were you looking to ask about our hours or schedule an appointment?
What are, what are your opening hours on Saturday?
On Saturdays we're open from nine in the morning until one in the afternoon. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

notes: Excellent responsiveness and polite tone. Answered pricing promptly.

messages.text: Starting session with Peak Physio Front Desk (Rachel voice)...
Hi, welcome to Peak Sports Physio. How can I assist you with your appointment or pricing questions today?
Hi! I tweaked my lower back running yesterday. How much does an initial assessment cost?
I'm sorry to hear about your back! Our standard initial assessments are 120 dollars, and we accept most major health insurance plans.
Do you have any availability tomorrow afternoon?
Yes, we have an opening at 2:30 PM with Dr. Sarah Vance. Would you like me to reserve that time for you?
